title: Infectious Disease Detection Capabilities of Southeast Asian Countries: A Landscape Analysis of Surveillance Systems and Stakeholders
description: Landscape analysis comparing infectious disease detection, surveillance, laboratory, stakeholder, and genomic surveillance capabilities across selected Southeast Asian countries.
keyFeatures: Compares detection and surveillance capabilities across Southeast Asian countries.
Maps gaps in laboratory systems, supply chains, data sharing, and coordination.
Identifies stakeholders and enabling factors for stronger detection systems.
Useful for cross-country learning and investment planning.
practicalUse: Use this report to identify system gaps, compare country readiness, prioritize capacity-building investments, and support planning for stronger infectious disease detection and genomic surveillance.
